Bike shops in Spartanburg: repairs, parts, rentals

Bike shops in Spartanburg that do repairs. If something breaks in transit or the night before, start here. Call ahead on event weekends. Mechanics get slammed.

For: The Assault on Mt. Mitchell.

Bike shops in Spartanburg: repairs, parts, rentals, listed

  1. Bike Worx

    1321 Union St, Spartanburg, SC 29302 · (864) 542-2453

    repairparts

    Spartanburg's oldest locally owned shop, since 1998; owner Eric Turner is a Barnett-trained mechanic. Test rides on the Mary Black Rail Trail. Closed Sunday and Monday.

  2. Trek Bicycle Spartanburg

    1735 John B White Sr. Blvd, Suite 1B, Spartanburg, SC 29301 · (864) 574-5273

    repairparts

    Trek store on the west side with a 48-hour repair guarantee and weekly group rides; closed Sunday and Monday.
